# oven_storage_drawer — articulation audit and repair

Status: FAIL / not physically certified. Geometry and export repairs are complete; the strict source-alignment and physical-hardware evidence checks remain open. See [artcheck_report.json](../artcheck_report.json) and [review triptychs](../review/artcheck_oven_storage_drawer.jpg).

The former fitted tilt was 4.0781 degrees. The repaired visible frame is upright to 0.000000 degrees, with a common appliance yaw of -3.06730 degrees. The door, drawer and both rack instances use the same level axes; yaw is applied once at the instance. Original joint names, materials and texture files are retained.

The tilted fascia/tray was rebuilt upright, coplanar with the oven metal front, with matching fixed side jambs and a lower plinth. The slide is local +Y. The empty thin-sheet tray and estimated 0.4 m travel remain; no warming-drawer function is asserted.

Final front-plane visual mesh sampling: 1996 perimeter points, maximum gap 2.617 mm; metal face coplanarity 0.000 mm. Rounded portions with no surface at the front section are outside this planar test; it is not a volumetric seal test.

Ten-step MuJoCo sweeps: PASS, maximum penetration 0.000000 mm. Parent/child collision filtering is disabled; collision masks remain enabled. The combined door/drawer endpoint sweep also has no penetration. Fixed welded components within one body are not treated as independent colliding bodies.

Source alignment: FAIL, maximum checked edge residual 27.83 pixels at 1280 x 1707. Camera matrices and intrinsics are unchanged. The source door-side traces disagree with the supplied projected gravity direction by 3.35–5.57 degrees on the long checked edges; geometry cannot simultaneously be upright and absorb this residual. Source traces have approximately 6-pixel uncertainty. Fits and scores share frames and are not independent held-out validation.

Observed-state reprojection: FAIL / unavailable. The source never actuates this joint, so there are zero observed open frames and no measured travel or stop. The report does not label synthetic sweeps as video validation.

Export verification: PASS. GLB versus OBJ vertex error 4.17e-09 m; MJCF versus declared joint motion over ten states 1.72e-08 m. Both MJCF and URDF load and retain joint names, axes and ranges. Each convex contact piece is watertight and has positive volume. Mass/friction/damping/actuator estimates are retained; component inertia follows the repaired geometry and remains estimated. MuJoCo uses flat proxy appearance; GLB retains textures. Cloth remains a rigid carried fallback and is not certified textile dynamics.

Viewer: front [0, 1, 0] in the Z-up asset frame; preferred view azimuth 90 degrees, elevation 18 degrees. glTF coordinate conversion is (x,y,z) → (x,z,-y).
